collection.title: Audi A4 Saloon 1994 to 2001 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: An Audi A4 Saloon 1994 to 2001 model requires a 21" wiper blade for both the drivers and passengers side with a Standard Hook arm attachment. All of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle.
